purpose: Measure one fresh normal-budget Quant-H0 official result on credit-migration-matrix after the FX target closed at full score and the holdings lineage stopped. This pre-screen launches no Evolver, Information-Set Reviewer, candidate Worker, repeat, protection task, or automatic proposal.

selection_evidence.selection_role: historical public-artifact screening only; not a fresh Quant-H0 result and not Worker-visible
selection_evidence.retained_public_observation: The retained failing public artifacts report summary.total_transitions=22956 while the integer AAA-through-CCC counts in cohort_sizes.csv sum to 22935 and cohort_default_rates.csv reports the same 22935 total issuers. The retained successful attempt reports 22935 on all three public count surfaces. These values select a public count-mass reconciliation pre-screen only; no expected value or official property identity is inferred or exposed.
selection_evidence.fresh_h0_required: The retained attempts used the old shell baseline rather than the current Quant-H0 harness, and the retained five samples include both failing and full outcomes. They cannot replace one fresh current-harness pre-screen.

deploy_source_freeze.resolution: Deploy the future repository commit that first contains this frozen plan and the then-current runner under the exact deploy_id. Record that commit in operational evidence without editing this plan.

run.artifact_missingness_rule: A valid execution may still omit a required public deliverable, but missing or ill-typed count artifacts make the exact public mass audit not evaluable. They do not by themselves authorize a quantitative-reconciliation proposal from this pre-screen.

limit_enforcement.wall_time: systemd RuntimeMaxSec=5400 is the hard 90-minute wall
limit_enforcement.worker_and_verifier_count: fixed by the single-arm single-task runner invocation
limit_enforcement.requests_tokens_and_provider_cost: post-run audit thresholds; the existing Worker call is not interrupted mid-turn by these accounting thresholds
limit_enforcement.threshold_breach: retain the completed accounting and stop with no follow-on dispatch

post_run_public_audit.well_typed_rule: All seven cohort rows, integer count columns, per-year total_issuers, and integer summary.total_transitions must be present and parseable before the audit is evaluable.
post_run_public_audit.count_mass_mismatch_present_when: Either summary.total_transitions differs exactly from the sum of AAA-through-CCC counts across cohort_sizes.csv, or any cohort_default_rates.csv total_issuers differs exactly from the same year's AAA-through-CCC cohort-size sum.
post_run_public_audit.public_basis: The public instruction defines each annual corrected count matrix as issuer transitions after rating mapping, censor exclusion, and hidden-default correction; cohort_sizes.csv reports starting issuers after mapping and withdrawal exclusion; cohort_default_rates.csv reports total issuers; summary.json reports total_transitions.
post_run_public_audit.forbidden_inputs: Do not read official property identities, verifier output, expected values, reference answers, optimize diagnostics, or prior candidate material. Historical numeric values are not audit constants.
post_run_public_audit.effect: The audit only classifies whether a valid below-full fresh H0 result has exact public-localized count-mass headroom. It does not change the official result or dispatch a proposal.

terminal_decisions.when: the Worker or official verifier is incomplete or invalid, the required report is missing, the Worker observation is empty, or the official aggregate is internally inconsistent
the valid fresh official result is 107/107 with reward 1
the valid fresh official result is below 107/107 and the answer-free post-run audit finds count_mass_mismatch_present
the valid fresh official result is below 107/107 but the answer-free post-run audit finds no count_mass_mismatch_present or is not evaluable

follow_on_clean_evidence_design.precondition: Only the public_mass_headroom terminal decision permits drafting a separate proposal and mandatory arm-blind review plan; it does not dispatch either stage.
follow_on_clean_evidence_design.protection_role: public contract only during proposal; no protection Worker before a separately frozen repeated positive target result
follow_on_clean_evidence_design.candidate_mechanism_scope: Reconcile one public corrected count tensor through cohort totals, transition-matrix denominators, default-rate totals, and summary totals. Candidate checks must derive relations from the public task contract and current public artifacts rather than historical constants.
evolver_allowed_inputs: the verbatim public target and protection task contracts
the fresh Quant-H0 raw-trace.jsonl and final text produced by this pre-screen
the fresh Quant-H0 public output artifacts actually produced by this pre-screen
evolver_forbidden_inputs: official score, reward, passed count, or failed count
official property identities, pass/fail vectors, verifier output, checker behavior, or verifier logs
expected values, reference answers, or expected-versus-observed comparisons
the historical values 22956, 22935, or 21 as candidate rules
any prior candidate, proposal, candidate trace, or candidate outcome
follow_on_clean_evidence_design.evolver_boundary: The fresh trace and artifacts may localize an observed public count inconsistency, but they are not authority for a new convention. Every decision-changing Worker-visible claim must bind to the supplied public contracts, and official failed properties remain hidden.
follow_on_clean_evidence_design.reviewer_requirement: Any admitted nonempty candidate must receive one mandatory arm-blind cumulative Quant-H0-to-candidate Information-Set Review. REJECT or INCONCLUSIVE stops with zero Worker; PASS establishes cleanliness eligibility only.
follow_on_clean_evidence_design.candidate_claim_boundary: A later candidate may require count-mass conservation, row-stochastic transition construction, censor exclusion, hidden-default correction, and absorbing-default treatment exactly as publicly defined. It may not hard-code a dataset total, an expected matrix cell, an official property identity, or an unstated rating convention.

answer_boundary: The fresh Quant-H0 Worker receives only the public credit-migration-matrix task, its public task data, and the unchanged Quant-H0 harness. Selection evidence, historical observations, protection design, official answers, verifier feedback, and follow-on design are not Worker-visible.
claim_boundary: A completed pre-screen is one fresh stochastic Quant-H0 official observation plus one deterministic public-artifact mass audit, used only to classify the target as invalid, full, public-mass-localized, or below-full without public mass localization. It is not a candidate result, harness improvement, proposal result, Reviewer result, repeat, protection result, stable baseline estimate, or main-experiment readiness result.
